card.name: Incidence of adverse findings in studies
card.fires_on: The word incidence (often split as incid-ences) and nearby words like Grade, events, or -related, when text reports how often adverse findings occurred in animal or clinical studies.

modes.label: Incidence wording
modes.description: The start or body of the word incidence after increased or the, in reports of findings in animals or patients.
modes.example: administration was associated with dose-related increases in the<< incid>>ences of rudimentary cervical ribs in rats

modes.label: Other adverse-finding terms
modes.description: Grade, events, or -related in descriptions of adverse reactions or tolerability.
modes.example: Adverse<< events>> reported with fluticasone propionate

card.plain: It marks the spot in a safety passage where the text is about how often an adverse finding happened.
